answer: Bind each identity to custody of one unique physical object registered on-ledger — a numbered timber beam, a sealed case, any tangible item peers can re-inspect. Each epoch the holder must photograph it beside a fresh nonce and answer location probes. One object anchors one agent; splitting it fails. A farm facing a tide of audits needs a warehouse of distinct objects, each stored and presented separately, while an honest agent keeps its single item on a velvet shelf at trivial cost.
